title: How do functions like alloca allocate memory from the stack?
summary: Raymond Chen's blog post explaining the internal mechanics of stack-based memory allocation functions like alloca(), describing how they manipulate the stack pointer to allocate and deallocate memory without explicit free calls.
problem_solved: Explains how stack allocation functions work at the machine level, demystifying the mechanism behind alloca() and similar functions.
why_valuable: Provides deep understanding of low-level memory management that helps developers avoid common pitfalls and write more efficient code.
